data.question: Which public primary records and official WEF surfaces confirm, narrow or falsify the institutional bridges left unresolved at depth 1?
data.method: Reconcile Reuters-attributed Rockbridge structure against filing-derived entity records; inspect PCAST governing records; cross-match venture and defense firms against official WEF surfaces.
data.framework: Keep network attribution, legal-entity filings, federal committee authority and WEF directory/content presence as separate evidence classes.
findings: Reuters attributes Better Tomorrow, Over the Horizon, Faithful in Action, Firebrand Action, Revitalization Partners and a Buskirk-led super PAC to Rockbridge.

IRS-derived filing interfaces independently identify Chris Buskirk as an officer or director of Better Tomorrow, Firebrand Action and The Faithful In Action; those filings do not themselves establish Rockbridge membership.
FEC identifies Turnout for America C00883520 as an active independent-expenditure-only committee registered July 17, 2024 with Janna Rutland as treasurer.

Executive Order 14177 defines PCAST membership structure, information-gathering role, DOE support and FACA administration; the March 25, 2026 White House release names Kratsios and Sacks as co-chairs and the first announced members.
Official WEF pages identify Peter Thiel and Ken Howery with Founders Fund roles; WEF also maintains an organization-directory page for 8VC.
A bounded official-WEF search did not recover an equivalent direct Anduril organization or leadership-role surface.
conclusions: Rockbridge component attribution remains Reuters-sourced while filing-derived records independently strengthen the legal-entity and Buskirk officer chain.
PCAST is a formally defined federal advisory structure rather than a generic proximity edge.
Founders Fund has multiple direct official-WEF surfaces and 8VC has a direct directory presence; the equivalent Anduril institutional link remains unresolved.
These records do not establish common control, covert coordination, policy capture or misconduct.
recommendations: Run final configured depth 3 for remaining Rockbridge entity records, Turnout for America filings, PCAST meeting records and canonical WEF normalization.
counterarguments: A WEF directory or person page is not equivalent to partner status or governance.
An officer role in an entity does not by itself establish the entity's membership in Rockbridge.
limitations: ProPublica pages are IRS-derived filing interfaces rather than direct IRS-hosted documents in this pass.
Bounded negative searches do not prove absence of PCAST meetings or Anduril-WEF links.
unresolved: Turnout for America statements and transfer records
